source.citation: Ekneligoda, T. C., Zimmerman, R. W. (2008). Shear compliance of two-dimensional pores possessing N-fold axis of rotational symmetry. Proceedings of the Royal Society A 464, 759-775.

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), read on the page text and compared with the image of the page
transcription.note: Normalized shear compliance G H1212 / (1 - nu) of a hole in a plane-strain matrix: the shear strain of the hole, in the engineering sense of the article, under a unit shear stress in the plane; it is 2 for a circular hole. The maps are those of Ekneligoda and Zimmerman (2006): z = zeta + m1 zeta^(-2) (Table 2) and z = zeta + m1 zeta^(-2) + m2 zeta^(-5) (Table 3), written from the outside of the unit disk. Table 1 gives quasi-polygons, the map of the regular polygon cut after two or three terms, the term zeta counted; only the column 'present' of the article is stored. The value of the square is averaged over the directions of the shear.
